note: Actual sessions as performed, not as planned. `exercise` values are ids or aliases from exercises.json. weight is per-hand for dumbbells.

sessions.actual: Home shoulders + back + PT hip work
coachNotes: First session back after 1+ year detrained. High set count for a first day.
10 lb drove reps to 12-30 across the board — confirms the load ceiling; buy heavier DBs.
Shoulder block is front-delt heavy: arnold-press + shoulder-press + front-raise are three overlapping vertical pushes. No rear-delt work.
Back was rows only — both entries are the same movement pattern. No hinge, no vertical pull.
adductor-plank came from his PT, so the Copenhagen family is already cleared. Earlier assumption that it was too advanced was wrong.
